name: @hepta/control-ui
description: Robrix-derived Rust/Makepad chat UI for Hepta

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.lint: cargo +1.95.0 clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p hepta-robrix-ui --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
scripts.test: cargo +1.95.0 nextest run --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p hepta-control-core -p hepta-robrix-ui --no-default-features --lib
